Open Dates for Prospective Parents
We are very excited to be running some ‘open dates’ for 2027 prospective parents and carers.
We are keen to showcase our lovely school, and know that for many families, it is important to visit so they can get a ‘feel’ for the school.
The dates we have planned are:
Please share this news with anyone you know who will be looking for a school place next September. Book early, via enq@saltdean.brighton-hove.sch.uk , as places at each session are limited.
We will require the following information to book you a place:
Please click on to the school logo to enter the website.
Thursday 12th November @ 11am
Saturday 14th November @ 10am
Wednesday 18th November @ 11am
